subject: Is it possible to include a spatial bias file, as in Maxent, in unmarked?

messages.author: f5371240ffba84b3
messages.subject: Is it possible to include a spatial bias file, as in Maxent, in unmarked?
parts: If one is using the Java MaxEnt application it is possible to add a kernel density map of where you sampled to account for any spatial bias in sampling area, can something similar be done in unmarked?

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Is it possible to include a spatial bias file, as in Maxent, in unmarked?
parts:
Dear Daniel,

yes, you can. But what would the sampling area affect ? Occupancy or detection ? I think that a point could be made for either.

Best regards  --- Marc
